content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Enable SCA ## slug: events-payment-gateway-setup-enable-sca ## seoTitle: Enable SCA ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End {{snippet.SCA_Setup}} If you haven't done so already, set up Stripe Checkout. To support the SCA flow, Stripe Checkout must be used with Events. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/stripe-checkout-1){target=`_blank`} to learn how to set up Stripe Checkout. (SCA support is only available through Stripe.) For more information about SCA and testing SCA for PayLink, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/sca#sca){target=`_blank`}.
